The '''Maxca system''' was an isolated star system in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Brak Sector Force]] began construction on a secret base in the system to act as a safe fallback position in case any main Alliance bases in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] were compromised.
